boundary.implementation: ROM-free sealed protocol core with injected case-runner boundary

implemented_invariants: strict canonical schema-v3 plan and digest loading
owner authorization bound to plan, source, model, teacher execution and case catalog
preflight identity refusal before case one
durable fixed-order claim before private case input access
durable model and route-cost-baseline prediction commitment before teacher action
immutable one-outcome ledger with no reopening or reruns
plan-global ledger namespace prevents a second authorization from creating a fresh attempt
hard crash consumes the open case and permanently marks protocol failure
restart continues only at the next unconsumed case
intermediate progress exposes counts but no case result or statistic
scorer refuses to calculate until all twelve ordered outcomes exist
primary exact McNemar calculation uses only ten challenge cases
two safety cases are reported separately and cannot alter the primary statistic
failed primary teacher execution is a protocol failure rather than an omission
final result is recomputed from the immutable ledger and never grants live authority

challenge-only primary and separate safety scoring
pre-claim crash leaves case one unopened and consumable
crash consumption, restart advancement and no reopening
runner identity mismatch consumption and protocol failure
